$comment: SEO 配图清单。只放【章节插画 / 文章封面】这一类——即 gpt-image-2 该干的活。OG 卡片走 next/og，数据图走真实数据渲染，UI 截图走 Playwright，压缩前后对比走 ffmpeg 抽帧。见 docs/seo-images.md。尺寸 1536x864 = 16:9，对齐 PostCard 和详情页头图的 aspect-video，避免 object-cover 裁掉构图。
styleContract: Editorial tech illustration, flat vector style with a subtle paper grain. Strict palette: deep indigo #1E1B4B, electric violet #7C3AED, cyan accent #06B6D4, warm off-white background #FAFAF9, and one signal orange #F97316 reserved for the single most important element in the frame. STRICTLY FLAT: solid fills and hard edges only. No photographic texture, no glow bloom, no nebula or particle effects, no gradient heavier than a two-stop soft wash. Isometric or straight-on perspective, never dramatic angles. COMPOSITION: balanced and centred, occupying the full width of the frame with even margins on both sides. This is a 16:9 cover image displayed on its own, so it must read as a complete composition — do not leave one side empty. NO scattered decorative particles, floating diamonds, dot grids or corner confetti — every shape in the frame must carry meaning. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO UI chrome, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO human faces. Calm, precise, engineering-minded — not playful, not corporate-stocky.

images.prompt: A single horizontal slider track rendered as a precise engineering ruler running across the frame. A marker sits slightly left of centre. Behind the track, one abstract geometric shape is repeated six times left to right, each repetition progressively simpler and more blocky than the last, so the sequence reads as detail being spent away. No numbers or tick labels on the ruler.
images.alt: Illustration of a quality slider, with a shape becoming progressively blockier as the value rises

images.prompt: A large translucent cube being folded down into a much smaller solid cube beside it. The smaller cube glows faintly from within, signalling that nothing essential was lost in the fold. Thin measurement lines connect the two, marking the difference in size. Isometric, generous space around both shapes.
images.alt: Illustration of a large video file folded down into a much smaller one while keeping its quality
